title: Free Online Presence Audit | Alethig Media
metaDescription: Find out for free what your business is missing on Google, your website and social media. A 1-page diagnosis with 3 priority actions. Long Island, NY — in English and Spanish.
heroHeading: Find Out Why Customers Can't Find You.
heroParagraph: We review your Google profile, website, social media and competitors, and send you a clear diagnosis with the 3 things worth fixing first. Free, no strings attached.
reviewHeading: Everything a customer sees before calling you.
reviewIntro: Most customers look you up on Google before buying. We review what they see — and what your competitors are doing better.

reviewItems.title: Google Business Profile
reviewItems.desc: Whether you show up on Google Maps, if your info is complete, and what you need to rank ahead of competitors.

reviewItems.title: Website
reviewItems.desc: How it looks on mobile, how fast it loads, whether it's clear and whether it gets people to call or message.

reviewItems.title: Google searches
reviewItems.desc: Whether you show up when people search for your service in your area, and which keywords you're missing.

reviewItems.title: Reviews & reputation
reviewItems.desc: How many reviews you have, how you respond, and how you compare with similar businesses.

reviewItems.title: Social media
reviewItems.desc: Whether your profiles are active, look professional and lead people to contact you.

reviewItems.title: Your competitors
reviewItems.desc: What 2–3 nearby competitors are doing and where they're ahead of you.

steps.title: Fill out the form
steps.desc: Two minutes: your business, your city and, if you have them, your website and social profiles.

steps.title: We review your presence
steps.desc: We analyze Google, your website, your reviews, your social media and your local competitors.

steps.title: You get your diagnosis
steps.desc: A 1-page summary of what's working, what's missing and the 3 actions with the most impact. If you'd like, we can walk through it on a 15-minute call.

faq.a: Yes. No credit card and no obligation to hire us. It's our way of showing you how we work.
We'll email your diagnosis within 3 business days.

faq.q: What do I need to request it?
faq.a: Just your business name and city. If you have a website or social profiles, share them so the review is more complete.

faq.q: Will you pressure me to buy?
faq.a: No. We give you clear recommendations you can apply yourself. If you want our help, we'll explain how and what it would cost — the decision is yours.

faq.q: Do you work with businesses outside Long Island?
faq.a: Yes. We're based on Long Island, but we do audits for businesses across the U.S., in English or Spanish.
